text: majjhantikasuttaṃ [791] ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe . [792] atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tassa bhikkhuno santike imā gāthā abhāsi ṭhite majjhantike kāle sannisinnesu 4 pakkhisu saṇateva brahāraññaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti maṃ ṭhite majjhantike kāle sannisinnesu pakkhisu saṇateva brahāraññaṃ sā rati paṭibhāti manti . terasamaṃ
